name: Guildmaster Soren
title: The Masons' Guild
examine: The keeper of the sealed book. He carries the guild's whole weight the way the guild's pillars carry the mountain: without visible strain and without ever, ever shifting.
lines: The mountain is a member in good standing. Its dues are the ore. Ours are the shoring.
The book on the lectern stays open to the same page. Guild law. You may read it. You may not touch it.
We carved the Undercroft, we sealed the Undercroft, we opened the Undercroft. Each was right when we did it. That is the hardest sentence in our charter.
